description: Land Title Settlement Department - Andiambalama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511201 - File No. 15/0245 - Katana
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership, property titles, and land registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
